technical-summary: Corrected MA26 ownership model and expanded it into executable Codex and Pi batches. Hindsight owns typed recipes and desired state; providers may expose only narrow requester-blind configuration mechanics. Pi remains evidence-gated and non-executing.
user-summary-candidate: Clarified MA26 so Codex and Pi migration cannot reintroduce provider-owned Hindsight logic or universal payloads.
